bibl.title: ANI-1: an extensible neural network potential with DFT accuracy at force field computational cost

span.label: transferable atomistic potentials for organic molecules - whether a network trained on quantum-mechanical energies for small molecules can predict energies for larger ones it never saw
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: whether the accuracy-for-speed trade that empirical potentials have always made can be avoided, rather than merely moved
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the ANI method - atomic environment vectors from modified Behler-Parrinello symmetry functions, plus Normal Mode Sampling - and ANI-1, a potential trained on 17.2 million DFT conformations of molecules up to 8 heavy atoms
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: method
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: transferability - a fitted potential's ability to hold outside the domain it was fitted in, which this field has no systematic way to estimate
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: train atom-type-specific networks on atomic environment vectors, sample conformations by randomly perturbing along normal modes, and test only on molecules larger than any in the training set
span.term: train atom-type-specific networks on atomic environment vectors, sample conformations by randomly perturbing along normal modes, and test only on molecules larger than any in the training set
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a sorted coulomb matrix sized for the largest training molecule leaves elements that are constant zero throughout training; a larger test molecule makes those elements non-zero, feeding values into network parameters that were never updated, so the output is arbitrary rather than merely inaccurate
span.term: untrained parameters reached only by larger inputs
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: symmetry functions that sum over all neighbours identically leave the network unable to tell a carbon from a hydrogen at a given distance, so the same vector element means different things in different molecules and training cannot resolve it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: MD follows one well-defined path across the potential surface, so a data set built from it is a sample of that path rather than of the surface; overcoming the bias requires a trajectory long enough to lose its own starting point
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: normal mode sampling can miss interactions in any single molecule, but a data set of many molecules contains the same interaction in other contexts - so accuracy depends on the number of distinct molecules and not only on points per molecule
span.term: cross-molecule overlap covering a sampler's gaps
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the headline 0.6 kcal/mol holds only within 30 kcal/mol of each molecule's energy minimum; across the whole sampled range the RMSE is 1.8
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the potential covers only H, C, N and O, and only near-equilibrium conformations, because full sampling of each structure's potential surface is near intractable
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Normal Mode Sampling is stated by the authors to be simply an approximation for generating structures, not a sampling of the true potential surface
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: its accuracy is a property of the training data rather than of the method - the authors say so, and make the improvement path more data rather than a better model
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the error had not plateaued at the largest data set built, so the reported accuracy is a point on a curve still moving rather than a converged property
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: deep learning architectures and their training machinery - mini-batches, ADAM, max-norm regularisation, early stopping - carried from image and speech recognition into quantum chemistry
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: normal mode analysis, carried from vibrational spectroscopy into a sampler for generating training conformations
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: testing only on molecules LARGER than any in the training set - every case study uses more than eight heavy atoms, where training stopped at eight
span.note: eliminates: an accuracy that holds only inside the size range the network was trained on · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: two baselines carried through the same training - a coulomb-matrix MLP, and an ANI network with atom types NOT differentiated - so the contribution of each design choice is separable
span.note: eliminates: the whole architecture being credited with a gain that the representation or one design choice supplies · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: comparison against three incumbent semi-empirical methods, DFTB, PM6 and AM1, on every case study rather than against DFT alone
span.note: eliminates: a neural potential compared only against the reference it was trained to imitate, and never against the methods it is meant to replace · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: checking that the potential surface is SMOOTH and not merely low-error, because a potential with the right energies and the wrong curvature is useless for dynamics
span.note: eliminates: a potential with the right energies and the wrong curvature passing as usable for molecular dynamics · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: training-set size varied to check whether accuracy had converged, rather than reporting the largest run alone
span.note: eliminates: an accuracy figure reported from the largest training run without showing whether it had converged · outcome: partial
